svg.title: Cut-only code footprint scenarios with fixed graphics source
svg.desc: Graphics stays at 71017 code lines. Baseline: total 150112, graphics share 47.3 percent. Supporting portion of three scopes removed with zero integration cost: 3872 gross lines, total 146240, share 48.6 percent. The 58 Renderer adapter lines are excluded. A proposed 50 percent investigation checkpoint requires 8078 net lines removed, total 142034. A proposed 52 percent peer-context checkpoint requires 13541 net lines removed, total 136571. The supporting-only gross scope leaves 9669 more lines before replacement costs. Net savings and feasibility are unproved; existing migration and release gates remain authoritative.
